title: Tiered Cache Blocking and In-Kernel Task Dispatch for Long-Context Prefill Attention on CPU
abstract: arXiv:2610.38809v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic AI drives significant productivity gains across diverse domains, but concurrent long-context prefills from multiple agents can saturate GPU compute resources. Although CPUs offer a viable alternative, existing CPU attention kernels fall short in adapting to multi-tier cache hierarchies and lack effective thread scheduling. To address this, we introduce TACPU, a high-performance attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and an in-kernel task dispatching mechanism designed for causal full-sequence prefilling. TACPU achieves up to a 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels. Integrated into SGLang, it reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x while preserving model accuracy.

translated_title: 面向CPU长上下文预填充注意力的分层缓存分块与内核内任务调度
translated_abstract: 智能体AI在各个领域带来了显著的生产力提升，但多个智能体并发的长上下文预填充可能会耗尽GPU的计算资源。尽管CPU提供了一个可行的替代方案，但现有的CPU注意力内核在适应多级缓存层次结构方面存在不足，且缺乏有效的线程调度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TACPU，一个高性能注意力内核，其特点是具有分层缓存分块和内核内任务调度机制，专为因果全序列预填充而设计。TACPU相比PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention和SGLang注意力内核实现了高达2.01倍的加速。集成到SGLang后，它将Llama-3.1-8B的首Token生成时间（TTFT）缩短了高达1.74倍，同时保持了模型精度。
tldr: 提出TACPU——一种采用分层缓存分块与内核内任务调度机制的CPU高性能注意力内核，相比现有方案最高加速2.01倍，可将Llama-3.1-8B的首Token生成时间最高缩短1.74倍且不损失精度。
en_tdlr: TACPU is a high-performance CPU attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and in-kernel task dispatching, achieving up to 2.01x speedup over existing kernels and reducing TTFT by up to 1.74x for long-context prefilling without sacrificing accuracy.
